## Reproductions and design preflight

Stateful actual-module real-ethers RPC loop: wallet 0.003 ETH, 100k buy actual gas, 130k padded, 3.5 gwei cap buys 0.002495 ETH and leaves 0.000155 ETH. After validated mined buy, 50k approval requires 0.000175 ETH before padding/floor; Max Sell blocks. Same-storage mined buy also remains locally pending until receipt refresh. Red tests/node-trade-roundtrip.test.js in critical tree.

Actual NodeTrading browser with 5 nodes: Buy Max All creates five pending records; after receipts confirm and focus/visibility fire, refreshCalls=0, snapshotCalls=1, confirmedCount=0, manualRefreshAll count=0. Following sell blocked by stale pending state. Independently, review focus/scroll moves viewport from 1082 to 3857 pixels without navigation or page error. User-device navigation/root cause remains unconfirmed. Red tests/node-trading-status-browser.cjs in UI tree.

Real-provider 50-node delayed RPC at 200ms/request: preparation 31.172s, total 61.595s, 50 ready but 24 sent before old shared 60-second expiry; 2099 requests. This requires a bounded intent lifetime and fresh per-node reviews rather than allowing old quotes to execute.

## Financial invariants and approved changes

Existing direct signed contract submission remains. Preserve explicit chain/runtime/token/route checks, nonce/balance/gas/simulation, 2 percent slippage,verified vault ownership,one-use reviews, per-node browser locks, durable recovery before one broadcast, unknown fail closed, ordered sends and stop on error/unknown/cancel. No signing/key format changes, fee increases, looser slippage, automatic approval-to-sale continuation or transaction write pipelining.

Max percentage buy retains futureReserve = GAS_FLOOR + current padded buy gas * reviewed fee cap * 3 for curve or * 4 for v4. This budgets one current padded-buy unit per approval and two for sale plus existing floor. Current buy gas is also reserved. Recompute monotonically during gas refinement; enforce reserve again before signing; expose it in review/UX. Verified envelope includes buy 100k, each approval 50k, sell 200k at unchanged 3.5 gwei. Future quotes still fail closed on higher actual costs; no guarantee of all future fees. Existing underfunded wallets need ETH; refresh cannot create it. Custom exact amounts keep their explicit semantics.

All-node intent deadline 5 minutes from preparation start. Each trade review retains its 60-second lifetime. Before each unsubmitted node, a review near expiry may be prepared once again and executed immediately. Revalidated review must preserve node/token/route/side/action/percent/exact input/spender, retain at least original minimum output, and not increase original gas/total-cost or fee/priority ceilings. Permit2 expiry retains same exact amount/spender and existing fresh relative approval lifetime. Never reuse an expired review or change approval into sale. Overall expiry, selection/session change, cancel, price/cost/input guard failure, unknown or error stops later writes. One-use batch consumed before first await. Initial preparation may outlive early individual reviews but not overall intent; renewal before execution is mandatory.

## Refresh and user experience

One coalesced read-only transaction refresh cycle, concurrency at most3. Observe pending/unknown hashes, verify through existing receipt checks, retain exact-hash/session/token fences, never overwrite a newer operation. Never increment the write generation, cancel active submissions, or occupy their action lock. Prompt first check after submission, visible-page polling with no overlap, focus/visibility coalescing, cleanup on session/token change/unmount. Pending/unknown stays blocked until verified. Prefer observing already-submitted nodes while a batch continues. Bound queued work; pause hidden polling and recover on return.

Refresh holdings once after terminal transitions or manual Refresh All. Keep last good holdings on transient read failure; report partial failures and last-update state. Manual Refresh All is available for a loaded session even before token verification. It covers every recorded wallet-node operation and available token/native balances, joins an existing refresh instead of duplicating it, and never submits a transaction. Token snapshot failure must not prevent a native-balance refresh request. Slow underlying requests remain counted until they settle; a UI timeout does not permit unbounded overlapping read cycles. Synchronize displayed row, batch and single-action outcomes by matching hash. Batch completion must preserve earlier confirmations observed while later nodes were submitting. Preserve previous-token operation recovery for same wallet.

Optional internal bridge: NodeTrading onNodeBalancesRefresh callback increments WalletWorkspace nodeBalanceRefreshVersion; NodeManager balanceRefreshVersion invokes existing read-only balance load under current finance/session/target guards. No account capability or vault ownership changes. Remove forced review focus/scroll; concise live progress replaces page jumps. Approval-only actions must clearly explain their confirmation and next explicit sale step. Max copy explains ETH retained for approval and sale gas.

## Account outage stability addendum

The independent actual account/write baseline confirms that two transient read failures discard the loaded wallet and stop the batch after preserving an earlier submission. This is part of the user's continuing wallet-loss complaint. The earlier decision to leave that behavior unchanged is revised; the tests must distinguish transient verification failure from verified logout/revocation.

The designated critical owner implements the approved interface in /home/tx/projects/hoodlabs-wallet-account-recovery. Temporary account outages should suspend all node financial actions while retaining the same owner's local wallet and screen. Successful fresh verification of the same identity/capabilities can resume availability. Cached access must never authorize signing while suspended. In-flight preparation, signing, and broadcasting must check the central suspension state. Actual logout, identity/capability change, pagehide and existing idle expiry must still revoke/forget. There is no new secret cache, changed encryption, increased idle lifetime or automatic financial continuation.

The UI must clearly show account verification is unavailable and provide a read-only retry. Transient network/server failures and timeouts may pause; malformed/fatal authentication and verified signed-out/revoked states retain terminal clearing. Background read requests can be coalesced; mutating requests are not replayed. Preserve stale-response and account-mutation generations. The root approved the precise preflight before production edits. The synchronous setNodeAccountAccess(identity, pro, ready) gate starts unready. Sessions bind to the verified owner generation; reviews and complete batch intents bind to a financial action generation. getNodeFinancialEpoch and assertNodeFinancialEpoch enforce that generation throughout asynchronous preparation, signing, persistence, broadcast, and review renewal. The first detected transient failure advances the action generation before the single permitted status retry. Recovery enables only new explicit actions. A session created without a verified owner must be restored again before financial use. isVerifiedNodeSession retains its existing live/backup meaning, and readiness does not enter the workspace owner key. The separate ExchangeFunding child is canceled or suppressed while paused. NodeBridge receives a narrow account readiness prop that disables financial controls while retaining its receipt and read-only status display. Ordinary pending healthy background checks retain the last freshly verified readiness until a failure is detected. HTTP 408/425/429/5xx, transport failures and the account status timeout pause; malformed responses, authentication failures and a validated loss of Pro revoke. PonsLaunchpad/NodeManager ownership transfers only after the status UI writer commits, preserving its refresh bridge. Independent suspension, recovery, identity-race, direct-vault and in-flight-write tests and fresh Astra High review are required.
